```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
gene_expression <- read.csv("gene_expression.csv", header = T)
```

```{r}

kruskal.test(
  Log_10_2_dd_Ct ~ Sample,
  data = subset(gene_expression, Target == "iucA")
)

kruskal.test(
  Log_10_2_dd_Ct ~ Sample,
  data = subset(gene_expression, Target == "TonB")
)

kruskal.test(
  Log_10_2_dd_Ct ~ Sample,
  data = subset(gene_expression, Target == "xoxF1")
)



kruskal.test(
  Log_10_2_dd_Ct ~ Sample,
  data = subset(gene_expression, Target == "mxaF")
)

```

```{r}
# Target 1: iucA
shapiro.test(
  subset(gene_expression, Target == "iucA")$Log_10_2_dd_Ct
)

# Target 2: tonB
shapiro.test(
  subset(gene_expression, Target == "TonB")$Log_10_2_dd_Ct
)

# Target 3: xoxF1
shapiro.test(
  subset(gene_expression, Target == "xoxF1")$Log_10_2_dd_Ct
)

# Target 3: xoxF1
shapiro.test(
  subset(gene_expression, Target == "mxaF")$Log_10_2_dd_Ct
)

```

```{r}
summary(aov(
   Log_10_2_dd_Ct ~ Sample,
  data = subset(gene_expression, Target == "iucA")
))

summary(aov(
   Log_10_2_dd_Ct ~ Sample,
  data = subset(gene_expression, Target == "TonB")
))

```

```{r}
# Subset data for TonB
TonB_data <- subset(gene_expression, Target == "TonB")

# Run ANOVA and save the model
model_TonB <- aov(
  Log_10_2_dd_Ct ~ Sample,
  data = TonB_data
)

# View ANOVA results
summary(model_TonB)

# Run Tukey's post hoc test
TukeyHSD(model_TonB)
```


```{r}
gene_expression_no_ox <- subset(gene_expression, Sample != "La2O3")
```


```{r}
wilcox.test(
  Log_10_2_minus_dd_CT ~ Sample,
  data = subset(gene_expression_no_ox, Target == "iucA"),
  exact = FALSE
)

```
